question: Do ESM++ small embedding ranks add locus-search value on top of MMseqs2 sequence ranks (S3 versus S2)?

methods.S2: per slot evidence max(token, w_seq * sequence rank); sequence rank = log(N_db / bitscore tail rank) from MMseqs2 -s 7.5 -e 10 --max-seqs 20000 (round-1 topk_seq)
methods.S3: per slot evidence max(token, sequence rank, w_emb * embedding rank); embedding rank = exact cosine tail rank, top 20,000 (round-1 topk)
methods.AP: primary AP of round 1 (bench.py / locus_search.evaluate): correct = covers >= 50% of the members of a same-type target with >= 2 members; wrong = overlaps a different-type instance; unlabelled and same-type-other hits ignored; hits ranked by score; AP needs no null

test_A_defensefinder_cv.queries: DefenseFinder instances with >= 2 members and >= 1 relevant target (n_rel > 0), all genomes (odd and even)
test_A_defensefinder_cv.folds: query genomes (unique genome_code of DefenseFinder queries) permuted with numpy default_rng(17) and assigned to 5 folds by permutation position modulo 5
test_A_defensefinder_cv.tuning: per fold, S2 config chosen among w_seq in {0.5, 0.75, 1}, W = span + {0, 2, 4, 8}, tau in {0, 1, 2, 3}; S3 config among w_emb in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1} (w_seq fixed at 1), same W and tau grids; choice = highest mean primary AP on the other four folds' queries (ties: smaller W extra, larger tau, then smaller weight)
test_A_defensefinder_cv.statistic: per held-out query AP(S3) - AP(S2); mean over all held-out queries; 95% interval from a paired genome bootstrap (query genomes resampled, 2,000 draws, seed 17)

test_B_frozen_other_callers.queries: TXSScan and CRISPRCasTyper instances with >= 2 members and n_rel > 0 on even genome_code genomes (type label as round 1: system_type for TXSScan, system_subtype for CRISPRCasTyper)
test_B_frozen_other_callers.configs: frozen at the DefenseFinder odd-genome values of round 1: S2 w_seq 1, W = span + 8, tau 3; S3 w_emb 0.5, W = span + 8, tau 0
test_B_frozen_other_callers.statistic: mean AP(S3) - AP(S2) per caller, with a paired genome-bootstrap interval reported

criterion: The embedding counts as adding value if (A) the DefenseFinder cross-validated mean S3 - S2 is >= 0.02 AP and its 95% interval excludes 0, and (B) the mean S3 - S2 is > 0 for TXSScan and for CRISPRCasTyper. All three conditions are required.
refutation: Any of: (A) mean < 0.02 or interval includes 0; (B) mean <= 0 in either other caller. Then the round-1 S3 - S2 gain (+0.079) is not confirmed as a general embedding contribution.
secondary_reported: recall at E <= 0.01 and unlabelled hits per query for the frozen configs (200-replicate null)

unlabelled_hit_evidence_rule.scope: a hit labelled unlabelled (overlaps no instance of the query's caller) at E <= 0.01
supported_if_any: a_own: a gene in the hit window carries a raw DefenseFinder profile hit (annotations.source = 'defensefinder', any reported e-value) whose profile name occurs in profile_names of at least one curated defense_systems row of the query's system_type

c_module: the hit window overlaps an engine conserved locus (dpann__mmseqs__seq__e3c50s75__w3, kind 'conserved', any level) whose module_id equals the module_id of a conserved locus overlapping the query instance's members
unlabelled_hit_evidence_rule.control: per hit, 10 span-matched windows drawn uniformly on the same contig among windows that overlap no gold instance of the caller (seed 17)
reported_also: any raw DefenseFinder profile hit (any type)
>= 50% of window genes inside conserved loci
unlabelled_hit_evidence_rule.non_defensefinder_callers: the rule is defined for DefenseFinder queries only

rate_constrained_selection.candidates: M0, M1, M2 (w_emb in {0.5, 0.75, 1}), S1, S2 (w_seq in {0.5, 0.75, 1}), S3 (w_emb in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}), each at W = span + 8 and tau in {0, 1, 2, 3}; plus M3 refine and grow, rounds 2 and 3, at their round-1 configs
rate_constrained_selection.training: odd genome_code DefenseFinder queries (n_rel > 0); AP = mean primary AP; rate = unlabelled hits per query at E <= 0.01, E from a 40-replicate circular-shift null with a fitted exponential tail (M3 candidates: round-1 200-replicate empirical E)
rate_constrained_selection.constraint: rate <= 1.5 x the rate of M0 at its round-1 config (tau 3, W = span + 8) computed the same way; if that M0 rate is < 0.1, the bound is 0.15 per query
rate_constrained_selection.exemption_variant: unlabelled hits classified supported by unlabelled_hit_evidence_rule are removed from the rate of every candidate and of M0
rate_constrained_selection.selection: highest training mean AP among candidates meeting the constraint (reported without and with the exemption)
rate_constrained_selection.test: even genome_code DefenseFinder queries: AP and paired AP difference to M0 (genome bootstrap), rate with and without the exemption
